tei:div.tei:p: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang chog bzhugs:

dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: de yi sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings: 'jug pa dbang gi cho ga ste: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis: bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor bkod legs par: bum pa gsang thod rig ma dang : me long shel rdo sku dang sngags: phyag mtshan dpal dang dur khrod chas: bsgral phur mtshon cha liṅga bcas: 'du byas bdag mdun gzhung bsrangs zhing : bsnyen sgrub las gsum bum pa'i nang : lha tshogs bskyed bzlas las bum sgrub: snod du nges shing don gnyer gyi: slob ma zung du ma gyur pa: khrus dang bgegs bsal srung bas bcings: lo rgyus brjod pas yid ches bskyed: maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab: he ru kaḥdapal dkyil 'khor gtso: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag: ye shes khro bo chen po yis: bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum skyabs sems rgyud sbyangs shing : sdom pa gsum bzung g.yar dam blang : rdo rje'i chu sbyin dam la bzhag: ye shes rdo rje 'da' dka'i chu: snying la bstim pas dam srung na: sems dpa' mchog gyur dngos grub ster: 'das na brlag par gdon mi za: sa ma ya i daṃ na ra kan: slob ma'i sgo gsum ma dag sbyangs: sras su bskrun nas phung khams kun: dag pa'i lha bskyed byin gyis rlabs: rdo rje'i ye shes nan tan dbab: gnyis med rgyas btab brtan pa la: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lhas: bdud rtsi'i bum pas gtor blugs bya: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa mtshan rdzogs nang : bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: rigs lnga 'dus pa'i dam rdzas 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: bum chu 'thor 'thung khrus byas pas: sgrib dag ye shes mngon du gyur: phung khams lha yi skur smin pa'i: byin rlabs brtan par bya ba'i phyir: hūm̐: mthing nag e yi klong dkyil ni: 'bar ba gar dgu'i gzi byin can: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur bas:

snang stong phyag rgyar sad par shog: ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bsnyen sgrub las kyi bzlas lung sbyin: āḥ rnam pa thams cad rdo rje'i sgra: rang byung gsang ba'i sngags su shar: dngos grub kun gyi bcud 'dzin pa: snying po lung gi dbang bskur ro: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ye shes sems pas thugs byin rlabs: hūm̐: 'khor dang 'das pa'i srog gi gor: snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' che: badz+ra sa twa tshon gang bas: bde ba chen po'i thugs dbang sbyin: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: stobs dang rnam thar brgyad la sogs: zag med yon tan legs mtshon pa: dregs pa bsgral ba'i longs spyod che: yongs su rdzogs pas dbang bskur ro: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i mtshan rtog 'joms: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum dbyings su gsod: khyab brdal thugs rje'i me dpung dang : phrin las phur bu'i dbang bskur ro: karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: yab yum rol pa'i byang sems sbyin: hūm̐: chos kun thabs shes mnyam par sbyor: bde chen bdud rtsi'i snying por 'khyil: gnyis med rol pa'i sems sprin sbyin: lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs shog: gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma hā su kha ho: shes rab mtshan ldan phyag rgyar gtad: hūm̐: bde ba chen po nam mkha'i dkyil: pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i reg pa yis: mngon sum myong zhing rtogs pa'i dbang : phyag rgya'i dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: karma mu dra sa ma ya hoḥ bzhi pa tshig gis don ngo sprad: hūm̐: mi gnas ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings: rdo rje rang byung 'od gsal che: rang la gdod nas 'du 'bral med: rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid do: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ nyams pa bsgral ba mngon spyod dbang : rū par gnod byed dgugs bstim dbye: thun gyis gzir zhing gdab pas grub: las kyi phur bu'i bdag phur 'ben: tshe khrus gnas lung dgongs pas gdab: hūm̐: sgrol byed 'bar ba kī la yā:

khams gsum sku gsung thugs su rdzogs: dug lnga bsgral ba'i las byas pas: nyams pa rtsad gcod dbang thob shog: drag sngags bzla zhing gtun la brdung : gzugs phung zhal bstab byin zar 'bul: hūm̐: e dbyings 'bar ba'i me hom du: rig pa rdo rje phur pa'i lhar: dgra bgegs sha rus khrag kun 'bul: bdud bgegs bsregs pa'i dbang thob shog: ag+ne dz+wa la a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri rab kyis: mnan na lha yang brlag nus pa'i: drag shul las kyis dbang bskur bas: gdug pa mtha' dag tshar gcod shog: s+t+wam̐ bha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: hūm̐: gdug pa zor gyi mtshon cha ni: rngams brjid 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul can: phung byed rdo rje'i mtshon chen pos: nyams pa sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: sarba sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bzlog: ma ra ya phaṭa: las gzhug rgyal dbyangs shis pa brjod: dam tshig khas blang gtor 'bul zhing : bsngo smon rgyas gdab las gzhug bsdu: rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras: kun kyang snying po'i dbang la rdzogs: thabs 'dis smin pa'i gang zag kun: yongs rdzogs lam spyod nus pa thob: de phyir 'di la gces par zungs: man ngag kun gyi snying po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: pad+ma gar dbang mdo sngags gling ba rang byung 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rjes yud tsam la bris pa yi ge gnyis pa'i grogs dan do skya chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa dza yan+tu// //
